item.mi_overclock_addon.overclock_memory: Goes in a machine's overdrive slot. Keeps about half of the built-up overclock when the recipe changes, and holds it steady while idle.
It still remembers the hum of full throttle.
item.mi_overclock_addon.persistent_overc: Goes in a machine's overdrive slot. Fully preserves the built-up overclock across recipe changes and never lets it decay while idle.
Once the rhythm is set, it never skips a beat.
item.mi_overclock_addon.quantum_overcloc: Goes in a machine's overdrive slot. Pins the machine to maximum overclock at all times while powered — even idling, waiting for inputs, or switching recipes.
It freezes time at the quantum scale, so full speed never cools down.
